title: Game-Creation-Agents: Autonomous Game Production
abstract: arXiv:2610.16776v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Game-Creation-Agents (GCA) turns a natural-language request into a runnable Phaser 4 browser game. The pipeline first builds a multimodal game design document that couples mechanics and scene contracts to grounded visual references. It then projects that document into a runtime scaffold, machine-readable contracts, and deterministic tests. Eight specialized agents next carry out production: scenes are implemented serially, assets are produced in parallel, and one reduced manifest joins the two branches into a single build. Build-linked real-UI checks and a code-blind critic then verify that build and decide whether the game may ship. Each blocker returns to the agent that owns the affected artifact for a bounded repair, and the game is released once all the gates pass. translated_title: 游戏创建智能体：自主游戏生产
translated_abstract: 游戏创建智能体（Game-Creation-Agents, GCA）能够将自然语言请求转化为可运行的 Phaser 4 浏览器游戏。该流水线首先构建一份多模态游戏设计文档，将玩法机制和场景契约与有依据的视觉参考相结合。随后，该文档被投影为运行时脚手架、机器可读契约以及确定性测试。接下来，八个专门的智能体执行生产任务：场景按串行方式实现，资产按并行方式生成，并通过一份精简清单将两条分支合并为单一构建。之后，与构建绑定的真实 UI 检查和一个不接触代码的评审智能体对该构建进行验证，并决定游戏是否可以发布。每个阻塞问题都会交还给拥有受影响制品的智能体进行有界修复，所有检查关卡通过后游戏即被发布。我们仅通过游戏渲染出的界面对完成的游戏进行独立评估，在统一协议下运行提示匹配的任务。GCA 在需求满足方面取得了更强的表现……
tldr: GCA 提出了一个多智能体自主流水线，可将自然语言请求端到端地转化为通过质量关卡验证的可运行 Phaser 4 浏览器游戏。
en_tdlr: GCA introduces a multi-agent pipeline that autonomously turns natural-language requests into runnable Phaser 4 browser games through contract-based design, serial scene and parallel asset production, and quality-gated verification.
